reviews.text: Always the best care.  Kind, caring, & compassionate staff that put you at ease when your pet is sick or injured.
I like the vet here and the techs are nice too

They told me they would call me if they needed to pull more than 4 of my dogs teeth.
The doc never checked how many it would actually be before they put her under anesthesia.
I had to call them just to find out if the operation was over and I could come back.

When I showed up they had pulled 33 teeth - THIRTY THREE TEETH!

My dog can never eat hard food again and they handed me a $7,000 bill - double the high end of the estimate.

Normally I don't write reviews but for this vet I had to. The experience i had here was amazing, every worker in their was above and beyond. Everyone was super friendly and the compassion in this place was outstanding. I definitely recommend you coming here for any of your pets needs. Not only were they very respectful to me but they did everything with kind hands and heart for my cat.

I called this veterinary clinic earlier today (4/29/2026 at 2:33 PM) to schedule my first-ever appointment for my kitten. I asked very basic questions - pricing, availability, and services - and was met with one of the most unprofessional and rude receptionists I’ve ever encountered - Edie.

First, the clinic requires a deposit, which is totally fine. However, they insisted on taking full card details over the phone, which I am not comfortable with, and I communicated that politely. I offered a simple alternative - sending a payment link so I could pay that way - but was told, “we don’t do that, only over the phone.” That’s fine. I then offered to come in person and pay cash, and was told the appointment would not be scheduled. That was also fine with me, and I said that, but I added that I could still come in person, schedule the appointment, and pay the deposit in cash. The moment I insisted I would come in person, suddenly the appointment was “magically” scheduled. That inconsistency alone is concerning.

When I asked about a specific vaccine (first shot of FVRCP for a 2-month-old kitten), I was told, “we don’t have it.” When I asked what vaccination they do carry, the response was, “I don’t know, you have to come.” That’s fine — not all receptionists know that — but then what explains the difference in pricing? I received no answer, however, Edie knew the basic information about my kitty (age, breed). Okay, I still wanted to come…

I also asked about deworming and pricing and was told “up to $75” with no clarity. When I asked about a specific medication (pyrantel), again the answer was vague and dismissive.

Throughout the call, Edie constantly interrupted me, did not allow me to finish a single sentence, and maintained a sarcastic and dismissive tone. Even if a receptionist does not know exact pricing or specific details, that is understandable. However, that does not justify the tone or behavior. There is no reason to interrupt a client or speak in a way that feels like you are upset or irritated with them.

Not knowing the name of vaccines or exact prices and giving a range is fine for me, but the rude tone is not acceptable. If someone does not like this job or is not prepared to answer basic questions, I’m not sure a veterinary clinic is the right place for them, especially when animals and clients depend on calm and professional communication. The overall attitude was careless, sarcastic, and borderline mocking. I’m concerned about the behavior toward my animal during the appointment. Is it gonna be the same aggressive and unprofessional?

I would like to speak with the manager/the owner/or a doctor regarding this situation. Please call me back. You can find my phone number by checking the list of income calls on 4/29 at 2:33 PM.

Thank you,
Kindly
Diana

I went to Marine Park Veterinary Group for a second opinion on my dogs eye and they were extremely nice and helpful. My dog is very nervous at the vet and they tried to make him as comfortable as possible. My dog also doesn’t take well to anything being put in his eye and Dr. Montella and his technicians spent time with me trying to figure out the best way for me to treat his eye. I appreciate the attention they gave and I will be continuing to take my dog here as his normal vet!
Love taking my baby here!! He recently had an ear infection and they were able to get that cleared up. Prices are fair and they always follow up after treatment.

doctor doesn’t have a good attitude. they cleverly  slide in extra services that you would think are mandatory but they are not. I tried getting a travel certification for my pet but the doctor said he didn’t have the proper license for it…

We took our new family members Strudel and PopTart (6months kittens).
Staff members and Dr. Pete Montella were so friendly, welcoming, even other pet parents. Answered my questions, explained everything and next visit. What to watch for after shots. Office very clean, exam room clean organized.
We are very happy with Marine Park Veterinary Group.

We visit them when we have to ,
They are very helpful
Charging alot
they literally overcharge you so much for things that can be done way cheaper in other places. this vet is not licensed which is probably why they charge you over the price. dont waste ur time here!

Nasty attitude from vet doctor & front office. They ran extra tests without confirming any details from us as a money grab. Charged over $300 for a $50-$70 tests. And over $800 for something that's $100-$200. DO NOT COME HERE.

The doctor also stopped getting his licenses updated (he's old and probably doesn't want to pay up) so he's not even a licensed vet to be able to do legit paperwork. Probably why they do all this under the rug thing.
Great staff and Veterinarian! All of our pets go here and we highly recommend this practice! Easily accessible, parking is readily available and wait times are short of any at all.

Thank you to MP veterinary group for your love and care that you showed to Jerry in his last moments. Losing my beloved kitty was an extremely difficult moment, but the sincerity you showed to us and him, we are extremely grateful.
Really expensive, prescribed my cat medication that did not work, but nice veterinarians. It feels like they are just trying to get you to pay unnecessary prices.
The kindest people, very clean and so helpful. They really love the animals
Caring, loving and very perfessional.  Kristen does a great job at grooming.

The staff here are wonderful! They really make Moose and I feel like family.
Dr Montella is compassionate and knowledgeable, takes his time to explain and never makes the visits feel rushed.

Never use this Vet. Hands down worst Vet service I have ever used or been to. The women who answer the phones in reception are completely rude and disrespectful. The prices are outrageous and on numerous occasions they won't even take you in to see your pets they always tell you to go and take them to VERG because they don't handle that stuff. Don't have one good thing to say about this place.
The entire staff are amazing people who love animals. I can't say enough good things about them. If you have a pet, you should seriously consider this place.

Everyone at Marine Park Vet Group is
compassionate and caring. My sweet Maisie has had the best care with them. I would recommend them to anyone. You can put your care and trust in them. Thank you 😊 …
Favorite brooklyn vet.

RIP OFF ALERT - I needed to get my cat neutered and wanted a ball park estimate. If you are a new client -  $50, then $80 for the exam, then " a couple of hundred" for bloodwork. Then you go home and they charge you for the neutering according to what they say find in the bloodwork. Then they schedule your appointment on another day. The woman over the phone had a bad attitude as well. Save your money and time.

SO so so bad. Dr. is gruff with humans, rough with pets, dismissive of concernes and doesn't even follow basic vaccination protocols that any idiot would know with the most basic Google search. (And certainly this person who has been running a cat rescue for years has known even long before I was ever in the business.) The cheaper rates are not worth your pets' health and well-being. If your just getting routine work, go to Flatbush Vet. If you need full veterinary services, go a little further to the south slope to Park Slope Veterinary Center. Or even Faithful Friends in Gravesend is better than this guy.

This is my 2nd time bringing my cat to this office. Everyone’s friendly and more importantly compassionate. I read some negative reviews about overcharging. I don’t think they overcharge. Exam+blood+urine test =$380. I will keep going to  Dr. Montella…

given some spiel about needing specific vaccines in order to get revolution plus for my cats. just another case of them trying to bleed their customers dry of their money. every time i come to this vet, they look for ways to fear monger pet …
very good vet , been with them for like 10 yrs , very gentle with animals and they know their stuff when it comes to your furry little one
Reign loved Dr. Peter on her first visit! Everyone was a pleasure!
